context: CI workflow for a cross-platform npm library. The team wants to verify compatibility across Node versions and operating systems.
explanation: Safe to merge. Replaces a single-platform test run with a matrix strategy covering three OSes and three Node versions with fail-fast disabled, so one failure does not cancel other in-progress jobs. The build step was correctly removed from the test job (it belongs in a separate build job). This is a standard, well-structured CI matrix.
